Entry Etiquette and Judgment in the Dothraki Sea Entry Etiquette and Judgment in the Dothraki Sea Disputes rely on tradition, chief prestige and tribal memory. The rules may not be written on paper, but they will be remembered by everyone; when a person is called "just", the locals may not agree with the Southern Palace. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
